structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The integrated digital cockpit embodies technology that supports the driver clearly and unobtrusively, reinforcing the article’s promise that EXEED RX makes driving easier.
structured_intent.primary_action: A single soft reflection passes across the existing panoramic dashboard glass.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The reflection has crossed the full display and faded at the right edge, leaving the original interface unchanged.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The cockpit remains a calm, premium driver-assistance display, with all interface content and state unchanged through the final frame.

prompt.positive: Fixed camera. A soft, narrow reflection glides steadily from left to right across the existing dashboard glass, briefly accenting the navigation display without altering any interface content. It reaches the far-right edge and gently fades by the final frame; every displayed number, icon, glyph, and control remains unchanged.
